titolo: Flipsnack boosts signups by optimizing ChatGPT Ads campaign
descr: Flipsnack focused its ChatGPT Ads on trial conversions, increasing registrations while cutting cost per signup.
paragrafi: Flipsnack ran a series of ChatGPT Ads aimed at encouraging users to try its platform.
The campaign targeted product signups rather than generic traffic.
Results showed a rise in registrations alongside a lower cost per signup.
perche: For AI users, the success shows that targeted AI‑driven ads can lower barriers to trying new tools. For those seeking free or local models, it underscores the value of conversion optimization in promoting accessible AI services.
